create_scim_user: create a SCIM v2 user endpoint that provisions users with email, name, and team assignments
update_scim_user: update a SCIM v2 user by ID with full replacement of email, name, active status, and team memberships
patch_scim_user: patch a SCIM v2 user with partial operations for displayname, active, externalid, name fields, and group memberships
create_scim_group: create a SCIM v2 group endpoint that provisions teams with displayName and member user IDs
patch_scim_group: patch a SCIM v2 group with operations for displayName, externalId, and member add/remove/replace
